rules.text:
Rules (DevOps confirmed 16/11):
1) Group = consecutive decisions with the same real event name on the same bot, each within 60 s of the previous one. Grouped events: Bid pulled, Ask pulled (each side separately), Quote skipped. No new requote log.
2) Never grouped: Order filled, Position cut, Stopped, Paused, Resumed, Smart quoting adjusted / back to normal, Order requests, cost warnings, errors, Unknown and Rejected results.
3) Group summary pill counts results of the orders in the group, worst first: Unknown, Rejected, Open, Partially filled, Filled, Cancelled.
4) Every result pill links to its order (by clOrdID), including Rejected (SELF_TRADE_BLOCKED, RISK_PER_TRADE) and Not placed · confirmed: they all have an orders row. The pill opens Execution & Orders with ?botId=&order=<clOrdID>, scrolls to the row and highlights it for 2.5 s, focus on the row. Not on the loaded page: filter by that order, chip to clear. No new panel or drawer on the Agent page.
5) Pill labels reuse orders.status.* (Partially filled, Unknown · reconciling, Not placed · confirmed).
